sentences.en: The extraordinary session of the Diet will last four weeks.
sentences.zh: 特别会期的议会将持续四周。

sentences.en: I've never heard such a thing, just an extraordinary story.
sentences.zh: 我从未听说过这样的事情，只是一个非常离奇的故事。

sentences.en: I saw at a glance that he was an extraordinary man.
sentences.zh: 一眼就能看出他是个非同寻常的人。
